caption:
Your personal details stay on your phone, not on external servers.

When you build your biodata, privacy matters for every family. RishtaPatra ensures that every detail, photo and imported resume is processed in the browser and saved only on the device; an account is optional.

Create your biodata safely at rishtapatra.com.
